* **One reusable suite release script**: `scripts/release_suite.sh
  <version>` merges each repository's green release PR, tags core first
  and waits for PyPI, tags the members, then checks Suite Consistency,
  the MCP Registry and every release's title and notes.
* **No half-merged releases**: the script checks that all six release
  PRs exist and are green, waiting for running checks, before it
  merges any of them.
* **No false Suite Consistency failures**: the check retries for up to
  10 minutes, because PyPI's cached JSON API can lag behind an upload.
